audio.py.summary:
Audio page class for HP Experience rebranding audio control testing.

- Inherits from HPXRebrandingFlow.
- Implements Selenium WebDriver interactions for audio control card elements.
- Uses explicit 10-second timeout for element visibility verification.
- Separates verification and interaction methods following the Page Object Model pattern.
- Supports visual regression testing via screenshot_compare decorator.
- Integrates SSH and Windows utilities for cross-platform or remote testing.
- Class attribute flow_name='audio' organizes tests by flow.
